headline.E1_identity: tick rate = Gamma Phi^2 pathwise; E[Phi^2|state] = D/(F+D)
headline.ages: b ~ n; N_V = O(n^{3/2} sqrt(ln n)); k ~ (2/r) n^2 ln n
headline.balance_band: mean-square vacuum fraction x*^2 = r/(4 C(Gamma,2) n ln n), r = Gamma + min(H, 2 Gamma) - m
headline.cycle_law: <Phi^2>_cycle = 1 - C/(Gamma E[tau]) -> 1/(1+c) for C = c D ln D (constant-rate form refuted)
headline.depth: word depth in [ln n, 2e ln n] E-level; reading x3 per depth increment
headline.full_lapse: Gamma-stratified recurrence (every Gamma=2 burst is a Phi=1 step)
headline.middrain: Theta(D log D) bursts per full drain; renewals die out as exp(-Theta(D log D))
